NAUTICAL MILES OF T1 

TROUGH T2 FM TD01F TO 15S 166W 19S 160W 18S 150W 19S 120W SLOW
MOVING. POOR VISIBILITY IN OCCASIONAL SHOWERS AND ISOLATED

STATIONARY FRONT SF 22S 160E 25S 169E SLOW MOVING. POOR VISIBILITY IN

WITHIN 180 NAUTICAL MILES OF TD01F, EXPECT CLOCKWISE WINDS 20 TO 25
KNOTS. ROUGH SEAS. MODERATE SOUTHEAST SWELLS.
